appDescription.message: Unofficial: Play Synology File Station videos in IINA on macOS. Authorize each NAS site once.

popupIntro.message: Open Synology File Station in Chrome, then click this extension to detect the NAS address automatically. Authorize each NAS once; future video playback is intercepted automatically.

manualOrigin.message: Or enter a NAS address manually (current site only)

enableIntercept.message: Intercept video player launches on authorized NAS sites

autoCloseTab.message: Close the temporary handoff tab after switching to IINA

popupSecurity.message: Permission is limited to NAS sites you choose. HTTP exposes credentials and SID; use trusted HTTPS. SID may still appear in an IINA playback URL—never share it.

popupFooter.message: Requires IINA 1.4.4 or later. Not affiliated with Synology or IINA.

unknownOrigin.message: NAS not detected · Open File Station or enter the NAS address.

authorizedStatus.message: Authorized · Automatic playback interception is enabled for this NAS.

permissionLostStatus.message: Permission revoked · Reauthorize this NAS in Chrome.

unauthorizedStatus.message: Not authorized · Click “Authorize current NAS” once.

registeredSites.message: {0} NAS sites registered (separate permissions and SID cache)

sitePermissionDenied.message: Site permission was not granted. Interception remains disabled.

tooManySites.message: You can authorize up to {0} NAS sites.

grantSuccess.message: Authorized {0}. Return to File Station and click Play.

notOrdinaryTab.message: The current tab is not an HTTP(S) site. Enter the NAS origin manually.

temporarySidCleared.message: Temporary SIDs cleared. Your browser's NAS login is unchanged.

settingsLoaded.message: Settings loaded. The current NAS authorization status appears above.

loadingNasSession.message: Reading the current NAS session from Chrome…

needNewSession.message: A new File Station session is required

sessionIntro.message: The extension first tries your existing Chrome NAS login cookie. If unavailable, sign in directly to your NAS here. Your password is not stored.

httpConsent.message: I understand HTTP sends my password and session data without encryption, and still wish to sign in over HTTP.

httpWarning.message: Connection details come from the File Station page. HTTP does not encrypt passwords or session data; use trusted HTTPS. Never share your password or SID.

handoffFooter.message: Requires IINA 1.4.4 or later. Chrome may ask permission to open an external app. Closing the tab is based on focus changes and cannot confirm the player actually started.

closeFailed.message: Could not close the tab automatically. Close it manually or try Play again.

playReady.message: Playback URL is ready. If IINA did not launch, click “Play in IINA”.

launchSent.message: Sent the request to open IINA. Once focus switches to the player, this tab will try to close automatically.

launchFailed.message: Could not open the local player. Click “Play in IINA” to retry.

nasUnavailable.message: NAS connection unavailable; could not verify the session: {0}

httpConsentRequired.message: HTTP is unencrypted. Confirm the HTTP login risk before continuing.

loginProgress.message: Requesting a File Station login session from your NAS…

loginFailed.message: NAS login failed (error code: {0}). Check credentials and two-factor authentication.

loginPermissionFailed.message: Signed in, but File Station access validation failed.

copyConfirmation.message: The playback URL contains a Synology SID session credential. Do not share, upload or publish it. Copy to clipboard anyway?

copySuccess.message: Copied. The URL contains a SID; use it locally and do not share it.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Try “Play in IINA”.

siteNotAuthorized.message: This NAS has not been authorized. Return to File Station and authorize the site from the extension popup.

browserCookieUnavailable.message: The current Chrome login cookie cannot access the File Station API. Sign in here to create a new session.

nasParseFailed.message: Could not parse or connect to the NAS: {0}

invalidNasOriginFormat.message: Enter only an HTTP(S) NAS origin (hostname/IP and port), without a path, credentials or query parameters.

invalidCurrentTabUrl.message: Could not read the current tab URL.

invalidVideoPath.message: No valid video file path found.

invalidVideoSegments.message: Video path is incomplete or contains invalid segments.

invalidSid.message: A valid File Station SID is required.
